launches.title: Outpaint.com, Ad Reframe - convert winning UGC ads to CTV
launches.tagline: Send us your UGC ad and get back a TV & Desktop ready version within days.
launches.body:
Today on [Outpaint](https://outpaint.com/ad-reframe) we are launching **Ad Reframe**, the easiest way for advertisers to convert their winning UGC (9:16) for connected TV (16:9). <https://outpaint.com/ad-reframe>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/0d9469eb-a8fe-4035-82b5-8b8101014f76)

**The problem**

Advertisers test endlessly to find a winning UGC video, then want to squeeze every bit of value from it, including running it on TV. But converting vertical to horizontal for the big screen today means black bars from pillarboxing or a smeared side blur.

**The solution**

Instead of adding black bars, we expand the content so it looks like it was shot natively for TV.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/9c2c0fed-b0bb-4904-a4f4-55b28373782d)

Outpainting wins on everything advertisers measure: engagement (skip rate falls to 17%, the lowest tested), quality (55% say it looks professionally produced vs. under 40% for the alternatives), and brand lift (consideration at 51%, favorability at 58%), because filling the screen with real content beats hiding the gap behind bars or blur. Report [link](https://outpaint.com/case-studies/ctv-format-test)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/79d0f1d7-f541-4f01-9255-c811dde479f9)

**How it works**

The conversion generates new content where the black bars used to be. We support any aspect ratio, resolutions up to 8K, any frame rate, and any color space.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/b9f35bc8-49fc-4b12-ac11-e2cb85002956)

Have an ad you want to convert? Grab 15 minutes on my calendar and we'll set you up. <https://cal.com/daniel-habib/15min>

launches.title: Outpaint.com - Expand any video to fit any screen
launches.body:
I’m Daniel from [**Outpaint.com**](http://Outpaint.com) (W21) and we are putting an end to **black bars** around videos, from vertical ads to big theater screens.

**Problem**

People consume video on many different devices, but video can only be shot for a single screen at a time.

**Solution**

Our models expand any video to fit any screen by generating content to fill the extra space, while preserving every pixel of the original video.

**Examples**

9:16 →16:9 (Ads and Micro-dramas)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102813&key=user_uploads/579262/e014ce0f-23db-4ee6-a6ee-f2e4269bd9c5)

16:9 → 1.43:1 (Premium big screens and IMAX full frame)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102813&key=user_uploads/579262/ab682ded-ee2d-4cb6-838b-b8f024ed41be)

16:9 →180° Fisheye (Domes & VR)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102813&key=user_uploads/579262/4e182eb6-7782-4047-bc53-6ed83af33ca1)

**How [_outpaint.com_](http://outpaint.com) works**

Simply send us a video link and your target aspect ratio, and we'll send back the expanded version. Our models handle any duration, resolution, frame rate, and color space.

We've expanded everything from vertical ads for horizontal CTV spots to full films for immersive screens like IMAX and dome venues. We even got a [**shoutout on Rogan**](https://youtu.be/D_ZGWj_38uA?si=hY74cps5IN5THreL&t=8415) for some of our VR conversions.

**Have a video you want to expand?**

Send me an email at [**hello@outpaint.com**](mailto:daniel@outpaint.com) with a link to your video, and I'll follow up within 24 hours with a quote.

launches.title: 🎥 QuickVid Autopilot - Post 1 viral clip per day to your socials
launches.tagline: Autopilot curates, edits, and posts the best clips from your existing video content.
launches.body:
Hey everyone,

I’m Dan, and I’m super excited to share that we are starting to roll out QuickVid [**Autopilot**](https://www.quickvid.ai/autopilot)!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81306&key=user_uploads/579262/891b19bb-7b43-492c-b234-ee213cd4a28b)

### The Problem

Consistently posting clips to your socials is just too time-consuming and expensive.

🕗 Time Intensive: Curating and editing a 40-second clip from a 30-minute video can take up to 1-2 hours.

💰 Expensive: A decent video editor can cost upwards of $200/clip

🖥️ Difficult to get started: Editing requires specialized software like Adobe Premiere

😰 You are too busy: Consistently posting to your socials is something that busy founders just don’t have time for!

📊 Trends are always changing: What works on each social channel is always changing. We stay on top of trends, so you don’t have to.

### The Solution

Connect Autopilot to your long videos and desired posting locations, and you’re done! Autopilot will find the best clip from all your video sources and post it on your behalf every day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81306&key=user_uploads/579262/a608e70e-d60d-4a25-98f6-97912f52d317)

**Connect your video source**

These are the locations QuickVid will pull clips from. QuickVid checks for new content daily. (YouTube, Drive, Zoom, etc.)

**Connect your video destinations**

This is where Autopilot will post your clips every day (YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, etc)

**Choose your cadence**

Either post once per day or let our AI decide the best time and cadence to post

### About the Clips

Clips are:

* Automatically cropped to a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio
* Auto-Reframed to focus on the speaker
* Baked with captions to help keep a viewer’s attention
* Personalized with your branding

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81306&key=user_uploads/579262/27645561-3a5a-4e38-af3a-0445c2ea712a)

### Who is Autopilot for?

If you consistently create long **_talking_** videos (podcasts, interviews, zoom meetings, etc.) and are struggling to keep up with posting clips, sign up for Autopilot, and I will personally onboard you!

[Sign Up Here](https://www.quickvid.ai/autopilot)

launches.tagline: A generative AI video tool that repurposes long videos into shorts in one click.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** QuickVid makes growing your Youtube channel effortless by creating ready-to-post shorts out of _talking_ videos (Video Podcasts, Interviews, etc.). For anyone looking for a hands-off solution, checkout our autopilot add-on!  

Hey everyone, I’m Daniel Habib.

I just pivoted and am re-launching QuickVid (w21)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77477&key=user_uploads/579262/c54acda5-8765-4d5b-8272-36a515c77504)

## **🧨The Problem**

If you’re looking to grow aggressively on LinkedIn, Youtube, or TikTok,  you should be posting **1-2 shorts per day**

For a busy founder, this can feel like an impossible task because:

* Clipping shorts out of your videos takes too much time
* Hiring a video editor is too expensive (sometimes over $300 per clip!)

## **🎉The Solution**

QuickVid is your automated video production studio. We take all of your source video content and repurpose it for different platforms at 1/1000th of the cost and time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77477&key=user_uploads/579262/77ffd30d-f607-44e8-a4d5-6955d2233e1b)

Clips are:

* Auto-reframed so the main subject is always in focus
* Branded with subtitles and special effects
* Spliced with B-Roll to keep engagement high – driving algorithm pickup
* Supported in over 10 video languages
* Editable, if you want to adjust a clip it’s easy to tweak
* HD - 1080p supported
* Graded with a Virality Score to help you find the best clips

## **How it works**

We use our own proprietary models alongside multiple LLM and video processing chains to find and spice up the best clips.

To use, simply drop a link to your video and once processed, you’ll have dozens of clips ready for publishing.

## **Full Autopilot (Beta)**

For those that are too busy to post their own shorts, we have an Autopilot add-on. Autopilot edits and posts one short a day on your behalf, it’s completely hands-off after initial setup. Every Friday you’ll get analytics on how your videos are performing.
